captions.title: New enquiries come first
captions.line: The inbox opens on the ones nobody has answered.

captions.title: Read what they asked
captions.line: Their message, their contact details and the listing they were on.

captions.title: Answer, then offer a next step
captions.line: Shift+Enter adds a line. Enter sends.

captions.title: They see it straight away
captions.line: In the chat on the site, and the whole thread by email.

captions.title: Replying moves it to Open
captions.line: So the team can see it is being handled.

captions.title: One fewer waiting
captions.line: Work down the New tab until it is empty.
